title: A match can end inside another
hook: A match can end inside another. Follow the computed steps.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
doesNotKnow: Emit suffix-pattern outputs when an automaton state matches a longer pattern.

misconception: One automaton state can report only the longest matching pattern.
objective: Emit suffix-pattern outputs when an automaton state matches a longer pattern.

claims.text: A terminal state can also finish shorter suffix patterns. Inherited failure outputs emit every matching suffix, so reaching one long pattern need not mean reporting only one match.
